title: OFSS Bihar Intermediate 11th 3rd Merit List 2026  @ OFSS Portal, Govt. of Bihar
intro: Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has Officially Released 3rd Merit List for admission in Intermediate 11th class (session 2026–2028) in schools/colleges recognized by the Bihar government. The application will be done through the Online Facilitation System for Students (OFSS) on the official website https://ofssbihar.net. Online Application Start on April 8, 2026 & 3rd Merit List Avaialble On  June 15, 2026. All Interested Candidates Can Download 3rd Merit List/ Cutoff Now in The Given Link Below..
importantDates: 2nd Merit Slide-up Process Date: 29 May 2026 to 02 June 2026
3rd Merit Slide-up Process Date: 15 to 18 June 2026
Payment Mode:  Pay the Exam Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking Mode Only.
Candidate have 10th (Matriculation) Pass from Any Recognized Board (BSEB, CBSE, ICSE & More) in India.

Note (CBSE, ICSE Board) : Apart from Bihar Board, the pass students of CBSE, ICSE and other boards will also be provided a separate opportunity to apply online. As the result of the CBSE and ICSE Board Matriculation (10th) Examination has not been announced yet, whenever CBSE and ICSE Board students will be released, then the CBSE and ICSE Board students can apply online. Opportunity will be given.
College and stream preferences selected in the Common Application Form (CAF)
Download Intimation Letter: Visit https://www.ofssbihar.net to download the letter.
Report to Allotted College: Visit the college on the mentioned date with original documents and admission fees.
Document Verification: Carry passport-size photos, Class 10 marksheet, and ID proof for verification.
Seek College Info: For queries, students can directly contact their allotted colleges.
Check their name in the list
Take admission in the respective college
Approach any college with vacant seats directly for admission
Click on “Click Here to Download Your Intimation Letter”
Enter Application Reference No. / Barcode, Mobile No., and Captcha
10th (Matriculation) Pass from BSEB, CBSE, ICSE or any recognized board.
CBSE/ICSE students ke result aane ke baad alag se opportunity milegi.
Merit List (1st, 2nd, 3rd) ke basis par admission.
Student ki choice aur marks ke hisab se college/stream allotment.
Science, Arts, Commerce, Agriculture & Vocational streams available
